4.    Learned APP seeks time to take instructions.           Hence, the
following order.
                                ORDER
(i) In the event of his arrest, in connection with investigation of Crime No.195/2021 of Police Station
Alibaug, District Raigad, the Applicant be released on bail on executing a P.R. Bond in the sum of
Rs.25,000/- with one or two solvent sureties, in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer on 24/2/2022 and 25/2/2022 between
11.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and as and when required and shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
(iii) This order shall remain in force till next date. Stand over to 10 March 2022.
